- Potato salad with mayonnaise (about 150 g): ~250 kcal, 3 g protein, 20 g carbs, 18 g fat.
- Fruit salad (about 150 g): ~60 kcal, 1 g protein, 14 g carbs, 0 g fat.
- Cola (about 250 ml): ~105 kcal, 0 g protein, 27 g carbs, 0 g fat.
- Chocolate-covered ice cream bar or snack in a wrapper (Magnum-type): ~250 kcal, 3 g protein, 25 g carbs, 15 g fat.

Total served is about 945 kcal.

In the second photo everything appears finished. Only sauce residue, a little fruit juice and the empty wrapper remain, so I put the leftover at about 30 kcal.
